name: Vague descriptions misroute questions
symptom: With vague specialist descriptions, the on-call stipend question may go to HLE Policy Router and a crew question may go to HLE HR Assistant; routing varies between runs (observe and record).
cause: Generative orchestration picks child and connected agents by name and description; no trigger phrases. Vague descriptions give no boundary between overlapping domains.
fix: Write descriptions with domain and source, concrete topics in users' words, explicit exclusions naming the right agent, and resolved overlaps (hotel caps and mileage go to HLE Policy Router). Re-run a routing eval set after every change.

name: Authentication propagation to connected agents
symptom: With HLE Front Door on No authentication, the SharePoint-grounded HLE HR Assistant fails to connect, prompts for sign-in, errors, or cannot answer (observe and record; behavior UNVERIFIED).
cause: Each connected agent keeps its own authentication; SharePoint knowledge needs Authenticate with Microsoft. An unauthenticated parent has no user identity to pass on.
fix: Use Authenticate with Microsoft on the parent and all connected agents that read user-permissioned data; document user vs service identity per agent; test non-owner personas outside the owner-only developer environment.

name: Conversation context across the handoff
symptom: With conversation history off for HLE Field Ops Assistant, the follow-up 'Does it have any open work orders?' may reach the specialist without SW-OH-30110 (observe and record). The child agent keeps context.
cause: Child agents always receive the parent's context; connected agents have a context-inclusion setting.
fix: Keep history on for trusted connected agents; if off, instruct the parent to rewrite requests to be self-contained with IDs from earlier turns and check the input in the activity map.

name: Debugging a failed handoff
symptom: Outage question fails with the mock API stopped; the parent activity map shows the call to HLE Field Ops Assistant and its result but not the failing flow inside it.
cause: A handoff can fail at routing, input, specialist reasoning or tools, or downstream systems; the parent sees each connected agent as a call and a result.
fix: Debug outside in: parent activity map (agent chosen, input, output), then the specialist's own test pane and flow run history, then analytics for patterns; keep per-specialist eval sets.
